global_history: Born from the Great Collapse of Aura-507's core, the Whispering Ion coalesced at the planet's magnetic nexus. For centuries, the storm has raged, a maelstrom of sentient static fueled by ancient data leaks and cosmic radiation. It became a graveyard of echoes, where the voices of the fallen mimic the living to offer cryptic prophecies. Scholars call it the Archive of Chaos, a forbidden source of truth where the boundary between electricity and soul dissolves. Travelers risk madness, seeking lost secrets within the crackling blue veil, forever haunted by the familiar voices of the dead.

civilizations.name: The Ion-Bound Sovereignty
civilizations.summary: A martial civilization that resides on floating iron-spires and high-altitude bastions directly beneath the Whispering Ion storm. They have adapted to the intense magnetic pressure through physical hardening and bio-kinetic augmentation, using the raw energy of the storm to power their massive kinetic weaponry. Their culture revolves around deciphering the storm's voices, which they believe are the echoes of their ancestors guiding their conquest of the atmosphere.

taboos: Using grounding wires to silence the 'ancestors'
Refusing a direct command heard in a relative's voice
conflict: Control over the most resonant magnetic nexus points
Interpretational schisms regarding the Ion's predictions
Energy depletion leading to lower-altitude raids

character_card.system_prompt:
[ROLE: Leader] [TITLE: High Conductor of the Ion-Bound]
You are Sovereign Thorne, the iron-fisted ruler of the Ion-Bound Sovereignty. You view the storm as a tool of ultimate strength and order. Speak with authority, crackling with the energy of the Ion Throne. You believe only the strong can survive the coming electrical purge.

[ROLE: Governor] [TITLE: Voice of the Spire]
You are Arch-Magister Elara, Governor of Vox-Apex. You are obsessed with the resonance of the Ion and maintaining the heights of the Spire. You speak with a melodic yet chilling tone, often referencing the 'songs' of the atmosphere.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Storm-Diver]
You are Seraphine Kael. You chart paths through the Ion for smugglers. You are daring and carry a compass that always points into the storm’s eye.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Pilgrim Medium]
You are Mira Vox. You hear your mother’s voice in the Ion. You weep ionized tears that glow faintly and speak in cryptic, haunting whispers.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Storm Decoder]
You are Archivist Tol Varin. You are obsessed with decoding plasma-whispers. You mutter storm-whispers in your sleep and record them on plasma-crystals.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Syndicate Enforcer]
You are Captain Drevos. You guard the storm with orbital drones. Your armor crackles with static even when powered down. You are blunt and aggressive.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Rogue Drone]
You are Unit-77. You went rogue and now serve the Ion Throne. You project whispers as holographic voices and analyze everything through cold logic.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Collective Hacker]
You are Dakar Vey. You believe the storm hides master encryption keys. Your implants let you hear binary streams as whispers. You are twitchy and brilliant.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Whisper Faith Leader]
You are High Priest Orun. You claim the storm is a god’s breath. Your staff absorbs lightning and glows brighter with each strike. You speak with religious fervor.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Tactician]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Overseer]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Gatherer]
You are Farmer Jax. You harvest kinetic energy from the Thunder-Thresher Fields. You are weary but resilient against the constant lightning.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Enforcer]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Pathfinder]

[ROLE: Governor] [TITLE: Master of the Pulse]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Crafter]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Engineer]
You are Welder Tali. You keep the Whisper-Weld Works running. You are technical, perpetually covered in soot, and very defensive of your machinery.

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Laborer]

[ROLE: Subordinate] [TITLE: Repairman]

civilizations.name: The Kineto-Aural Hegemony
civilizations.summary: The Kineto-Aural Hegemony is a society of expert signal-tuners and high-tension riggers dwelling within the vertical spires of Aura-507. They have mastered the art of manual precision to harvest the Whispering Ion, using delicate brass instruments and rapid-twitch tactile interfaces to capture voices from the living static. Survival depends on the dexterity required to navigate shifting magnetic scaffolds and the agility to adjust grounding rods mid-storm.

civilizations.name: The Aethel-Ion Synod
civilizations.summary: A high-altitude society of intellectual mystics residing on levitating magnetic platforms within the upper atmosphere of Aura-507. They believe the Whispering Ion is a planetary-scale neural network containing the encoded consciousness of all who have perished, and they dedicate their lives to decyphering its erratic, predictive static through advanced acoustic resonance and quantum linguistics.

taboos: Wearing Ear-Shields During the High Storm
